title: Follow-up: authoritative obligation registry and evidence contract
description: Receiving follow-up for the reduced PR #475 scope; owned by the obligation-authority work corresponding to eshyra-o9bd.19.1.12. Restore regression coverage for source-derived registry construction and validation, canonical obligation identity bound to evidence (including repeated occurrences), known-missing-source-clause supplemental gap evidence, conjunctive versus alternative multi-part evidence, capability/facet authority immutability, and scalar identity namespace reservations. These tests were intentionally removed from packages/core/test/clauseIrObligations.test.ts because PR #475 now consumes ObligationSource without constructing or validating authority.
acceptance_criteria: Provide an authoritative source census/registry API; represent and validate known-missing gap evidence without making it capturable; validate all identity/evidence parts and multi-part evidence semantics; deep-freeze or encapsulate authority; restore adversarial regression tests.
notes: ADR-0020 disposition (2026-09-10): Duplicate/superseded by corrected eshyra-o9bd.19.1.12 for bounded obligation authority and eshyra-o9bd.19.1.16 for evidence claims.
close_reason: Duplicate/superseded by corrected eshyra-o9bd.19.1.12 for bounded obligation authority and eshyra-o9bd.19.1.16 for evidence claims.
